retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome photograph of a muscular torso holding a sledgehammer, featuring a circular typographic lockup in vibrant red.
triggerTerms: circular red text on black and white photo
excludeWhen: soft lighting or pastel colors are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, high-contrast black and white close-up of a shirtless, sweaty man gripping a heavy sledgehammer across his chest, with a circular arrangement of bold red sans-serif text positioned over the upper left pectoral area.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome background vs. vibrant red typography
Diagonal line of the hammer handle bisecting the frame
Circular text path contrasting with the linear hammer and muscular anatomy
Tactile texture of sweat and skin against the cold metal of the hammer head
coreInvariants: Circular text path for secondary information
High-contrast black and white photographic base
Vibrant red as the sole accent color for type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A muscular torso fills the frame, with hands and a sledgehammer positioned centrally in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark head of the sledgehammer in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal hammer handle from the bottom left hands up to the hammer head, then circles back to the red text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject's body and the tool.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white photography providing tonal depth and texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the shadows and hammer head.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red used exclusively for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the monochrome image with a single high-saturation red element.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers are stylized with a slight italic lean and interlocking or overlapping elements
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, stylized numeric logo is centered within a circular ring of sans-serif text.
graphicDevices: Drop shadow on text for legibility against skin

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and industrial feel.
Offers a classic, sturdy sans-serif look that matches the grit.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a sweaty, muscular shirtless man holding a heavy sledgehammer diagonally across his chest. The lighting should be harsh to emphasize muscle definition and skin texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a circular path of bold red sans-serif text in the upper left area. Place a larger, stylized numeric logo in the center of the circle.

Is the red color vibrant and contrasting against the grayscale?
Does the photography maintain high contrast and visible sweat texture?
